pro_course_detail.title: The 5 Most Common Verb Tenses (97% of all tenses used)
pro_course_detail.description:
Introduction
   Verbs are the most important of the 9 Parts of Speech.
   97% of spoken and written English uses only 5 Verb Tenses.
   These 5 tenses are used in informal, business, and even academic speaking and writing.

Goal
   By the end of this short course,
   you will learn when to use and how to use these critical 5 tenses.

Objectives
   This short course will enable you to:
   -  recognize the 4 principle parts of verbs
   -  know the difference between regular and irregular verbs
   -  identify the most important tenses used in writing and speaking
   -  master the use of the 5 most common tenses (=97% of speaking and writing)
   -  develop the skill of using the correct verb tense in speech or in writing
   -  communicate effectively

pro_course_detail.title: NATURAL ENGLISH CONVERSATION AND FUNCTION IN DAILY LIFE.(FLUENCY/NATURAL PROGRESSION)

The lesson also includes cultural tips. We will do many student based role plays in which you will assisted and guided to speak English fluently.

Example a guest is at your house, Would offer the guest a beverage by asking 

1)Would you like a drink? 
2) Would you like something to drink?

Are they the same? 

Actually not.

1) means alcoholic drink e.g (Beer,vodka etc)
2)means soft drinks e.g (juice, water,coffee)

Please join me and in every lesson we can explore a different function of English, learn lots of natural key phrases and how to progress the conversation naturally to avoid language and cultural miscommunication.

This course is for students who would like to engage and respond to English speakers in social and everyday situations with ease and be able to join and fit into conversations without sounding unnatural.

pro_course_detail.description:

Here's how it typically goes, and many students find it helpful:

📝 Writing: First, you tackle Part 1 or Part 2 of the Writing test as homework. In the initial 15 minutes of our class, we go over your major trouble spots to ensure steady progress.
